name: comp-296
title: Live Event Notification
blurb: Live event notification with countdown and notify button.
description: Static live event notification with radio icon, event title, date/time, notify button, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to alert users about upcoming live events with an option to receive notifications.
avoid_when: For past events or non-urgent information; use a standard banner instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icon wrapper marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
